description: Edit your profile like Edit Profile in the app: displayName, bio, location, website, instagram, twitter, facebook, tiktok. Only fields you pass change; an empty string clears an optional field. Photos and handle aren't changed here (see set_username). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: update_profile
